historical_source.bulk_objective: 20 times trapezoidal integral of 0.5*(u_x^2+u^2)-f*u on [-10,10], without a boundary load term
historical_source.label_correction: The source calls the first displayed snapshot 1/5 Adam, but the condition is it == 5000 // 3, namely 1666. It is described by its actual step in current text.
historical_source.limits: The saved historical output gives parameter values to six decimal places, not an exact full-precision checkpoint ledger. Rerunning the source may produce different LBFGS values across environments.

interpretation: This is a slope-collision companion to the fixed-slope bias-collision experiment, with a different target.
After sign-normalizing the second neuron using tanh(-z)=-tanh(z), effective hidden slopes coalesce and large weighted neurons cancel.
The last two columns are separate LBFGS continuations from the same Adam endpoint, not consecutive checkpoints of one LBFGS run.
reproduction: The published PDF is preserved unchanged. A fresh run uses the exact historical source; the precise historical states cannot be reconstructed from the rounded snapshots. The separate later companion run is not included.
